title: A member who renews a day late, or leaves and comes back, is wiped from the finger machine and is refused at the door
what: On a basic finger or face machine, the day a plan runs out MettleUp deletes the member from the machine, and deleting also wipes their fingerprint or face. Archiving a member deletes them from every kind of machine, even the kind that could just switch them off. When the member renews a day or more late, or comes back months later, MettleUp puts the number back on the machine but the finger or face is gone, so the door refuses a member who has just paid. Nothing tells the desk this happened: the member page only shows the same 'Enrol this member's finger or face' line it always shows.
expected: A machine that can switch a member off keeps their finger or face (switched off, not deleted), also when archived. On a basic machine, a renewal or a return after a removal tells the desk plainly that the finger was removed when the plan ended and must be enrolled again.
who: gyms with a finger or face machine (not live yet), and their returning members
how_often: every late renewal on a basic machine, every member who comes back after being archived
fix_line: Switch members off instead of deleting them where the machine allows it, and tell the desk when a finger must be enrolled again

title: A member archived, or a plan cancelled, while an entry machine is switched off stays on that machine after it is switched back on
what: When the owner switches an entry machine off (for a repair, or the gym is closed for a while), the admin app throws away the list of members whose right to come in changed, and sends updates only to machines that are on. The daily catch-up that runs when the machine is switched back on only sees plans that started or ended by date. It cannot see an archive or a cancelled plan, because it judges the past with today's records. The same happens when a desk makes such a change offline and closes the tab before the internet is back: the list is kept only in the open page. So a member who was archived, or whose plan was cancelled and refunded, keeps getting in through the door.
expected: Every archive or cancel reaches every machine, including one switched off at the time or a desk that was offline: the change is kept until the machine is on again, or the catch-up compares what the machine holds with who may come in today.
who: gyms with an entry machine (not live yet)
how_often: every archive or cancel made while a machine is off, or offline on a desk that closes before it reconnects
fix_line: Keep each member change until every machine has it, and let the catch-up re-send everyone whose access differs from what the machine holds

items.reason: Web panel: no install package, sideload, watch or phone version split here. An open tab across a deploy is never told to reload (FN-B-time-panel-assistant-01). An older server is handled in every part: payments read 'not switched on' on a 404, branches say 'coming' without 0031, the pack gate keeps every feature on without 0046. The move to the new address carries the gym, branch keys and theme but not the language (FN-B-truth-panel-pay-machines-a-04), waits for unsent items, and the 'moved' note shows once, only after a real move. Payment connections made during test mode stay Connected and fail after live payments start (FN-L5-panel-pay-machines-03). Entry machine firmware: only the T&A and AC push kinds are known, and the AC fields are not proven on a real machine; written as unknown, no finding.

Plan end on a door machine: a lapsed member on a basic machine is removed only when an admin app is open (FN-B-truth-panel-pay-machines-a-03), and the removal wipes the finger (new 01). Gym pauses: changes made while a machine is switched off never reach it (new 02). Member leaves and returns: a number is given again on return, the finger is gone (01). Branches: a branch can never be closed (FN-L14-panel-pay-machines-03); a new branch takes the first one's paid plan (FN-L5-panel-pay-machines-01). Owner changes phone: branch keys are kept per owner mobile and remade when they no longer match. Leap day and year end: the demo birthday keeps a leap day (year minus 28), machine times are checked as real dates, month labels use UTC on a plain date. The demo is rebuilt from today on every open, so a 6-month gap shows fresh dates. A run-out payment link has a make-new button; a cancelled one does not (FN-L5-panel-pay-machines-07).

New-only flows in this area: entry machine numbers (existing members are given one automatically), the move to the new address (existing desks are sent over only when safe), the pack gate (a gym with no pack picked stays fully open), and live online payments, where connections made in test mode are left Connected and broken.
Paths exist for machine numbers, the move and the pack. Test-era payment connections have none: Paste keys is hidden while Connected shows.
Rule applied: the test-era payment connection is already a finding; reused.

The only 'new' mark in this area is the 'MettleUp is now at app.mettleup.fit' note. It is set only by the old address during a real move, for that tab, and shown once; a brand-new desk never sees it. No dots, What's new or tips live in these folders.
Rule applied: no new mark here shows on something that is not new to the reader.
